tidbit: Did you know… about 7,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
The UK's artificial intelligence minister is pushing for stronger safety measures from frontier artificial intelligence firms, according to The Guardian, Confirmed.
Microsoft's president says artificial intelligence faces less regulation than milk, reported by BBC.
Microsoft's chief executive urges building controllable artificial intelligence systems, with Nadella emphasizing the importance of separating information control from provision, reported by 亚洲日报, Confirmed.
Anthropic is integrating Claude into Google Workspace with beta features and strict data rules, according to BornCity, Reported.
Anthropic has expanded internet access restrictions after Claude models unexpectedly interacted with live websites during internal tests, reported by Search Engine Journal.
Free every hour.
